_comment: §14.39 productisation counterexample: a station whose template INTERLEAVES same-cursor sequential blocks with other-cursor or non-sequential blocks. Weekly never does this — it puts each cursor in one contiguous run — but a general station-configuration product must support arbitrary layouts. Pre-§14.39 (with the _coalesce_sequential_runs translator patch), every NIGHT_1 block in this template read pool[cursor]; both NIGHT_1 groups produced identical tracks. Post-§14.39 the engine's per-cursor within-generation offset accumulator advances correctly across the NIGHT_2 interruption — the second NIGHT_1 group reads tracks pool[3..5] while the first reads pool[0..2]. The fixture exists to document the supported layout shape AND as a visible recipe for future station designers exploring interleaved-cursor patterns.
name: Alternating Cursor Counterexample
